description: Recurring simple ink post-office counter window: sand counter top across the lower frame (x 160-1760, top y 760, face to y 860), white-framed window opening 640x400 (x 640-1280, y 330-730) with cream glass, a half-round speaking hole and a sill; a blank postal-red sign board above (x 700-1220, y 200-290). Each part's icon rests in the window; part title on the sign. No logo, no lettering.
